question: The number of solutions to the pair of linear equations 5x - 3y = 7 and 7x + 4y = 18 is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Check the **ratio of coefficients** of **x** and **y** for the given **linear equations**.

Ratio of **x-coefficients** (a₁/a₂) = 5/7

Ratio of **y-coefficients** (b₁/b₂) = −3/4

Since 5/7 ≠ −3/4, the **lines intersect** at exactly one point.

**∴ The correct answer is one.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Equation 1: 5x − 3y − 7 = 0 (a₁ = 5, b₁ = −3, c₁ = −7)

Equation 2: 7x + 4y − 18 = 0 (a₂ = 7, b₂ = 4, c₂ = −18)

**Formula Used:**

For a **unique solution**: a₁/a₂ ≠ b₁/b₂

For **no solution**: a₁/a₂ = b₁/b₂ ≠ c₁/c₂

For **infinitely many solutions**: a₁/a₂ = b₁/b₂ = c₁/c₂

**Calculations:**

⇒ a₁/a₂ = 5/7

⇒ b₁/b₂ = −3/4

⇒ 5/7 ≠ −3/4

⇒ a₁/a₂ ≠ b₁/b₂

**∴ The correct answer is one.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Consistent System

A system of equations is **consistent** if it has at least one solution (either a **unique solution** or **infinite solutions**).

Inconsistent System

A system is **inconsistent** if there is no solution, which occurs when the lines are **parallel** (a₁/a₂ = b₁/b₂ ≠ c₁/c₂).

Graphical Representation

A **unique solution** corresponds to **intersecting lines**, while **infinite solutions** correspond to **coincident lines**.</p
